rows.en: Touya: "Whoa... Did we get through...?! What happened to everyone...?"
Touya: "We can't go back... So it's just us from this point on..."
Kururu: "..."
Touya: "What's wrong?"
Kururu: "...I've got a bad feeling..."
Yamato: "It's strange that only Rayblade can get through.
It feels as though something quite deliberate
is behind this, though..."
Touya: "But if we can't go back, we've got to keep going. Let's go."
Kururu: "Huh... Is this the 'Core'...?"
Yamato: "It's ridiculously enormous..."
Voice: (Welcome to my castle.)
Touya: "?! What the... Directly into my head..."
Kururu: "What's wrong?"
Touya: "You can't hear it?"
Kururu: "No. I can't hear anything..."
Touya: "I see...
Someone is speaking directly into my head right now."
Kururu: "...?"
Voice: (Finally, someone has made it all the way here...)
Touya: (...Who the hell are you?)
Voice: (Ah, I see... How about this?
Isn't this a voice you know well?)
Touya: (That's... Debish?!
You bastard, you're still alive?!)
Voice: (Hahahahaha!)
Touya: (What's so damn funny?!)
Voice: (...Ah, my apologies.
Your reasoning was simply so shallow.
I did once reside within him, but I am not him.
Let's see... Think of me as something like
that being from Lin Karma who accompanied you.
You would not be mistaken.)
Touya: (A consciousness that exists even after losing its body...)
Voice: (Though I am something more pure and fundamental.
In any event, you have done very well.
I never expected that failure back then to produce this outcome.)
Touya: (Back then... You don't mean 109 years ago...)
Voice: (Just so. I thought it would go well...
But it did lead to the appearance of someone as exceptional as you.
Perhaps the result means it was not a mistake, after all.
They did well for me too.
Debish, Lyle, Bernst... And Sharl.
They all worked so devotedly for my sake...)
Touya: (What the hell is your goal?)
Voice: (...You humans of the solar system were most amusing
creatures.
You think nothing of sacrificing your own kind to satisfy your desires,
yet you also try to save them...
How very interesting.
I never tire of observing your actions.
What was that called...? Ah, yes.
In your world, I believe you call it 'entertainment'?)
Touya: (Entertainment... you say...?)
Voice: (Yes, entertainment.
You struggle and suffer... And still you stand against me.
There is no greater entertainment than a genuine battle
where lives hang in the balance... Hehehehe.)
Touya: (Why would you do that?!)
Voice: (Why? What an amusing question.
Because I am bored, of course.
We are free from the bondage of time and can create even the future.
For beings such as us,
daily life is nothing but boredom.
So chosen beings like myself
indulge in games like this to pass the time.
Yes, wagering the extinction of our own existence.)
Touya: (You're bored...? You bastard...
Just for that...!!)
Voice: (...Have you ever simply let yourself drift
in the aimless flow of time?
Nothing changes. The same moments simply pass by...
At first, I too believed that was only natural.
I did not even question it. But I was wrong.
On distant stars, far beyond our galaxy,
I observed the ways of humans who live for only an instant.
They brought a moment of solace to my hollow heart.
Risking their lives, fighting and prevailing, they showed me the radiance of life.
This excitement that I felt
was understood by only a very few.
But that is immaterial.
For now I am passing my time in fulfillment.)
Touya: (I won't forgive you... Toying with people's lives
to keep yourself from getting bored... I'll never forgive you!!)
Voice: (Good. Yes, come at me with that spirit.
Humanity's future lies in your hands now.
In those of that Rayblade you pilot.)
Touya: (What do you mean?)
Voice: (Whenever humanity has faced a crisis in recorded history,
there has always been something to stop it, has there not?
Sometimes it was a person, sometimes a sword,
sometimes a philosophy...
Something suited to its time saved humanity.
Have you never wondered why
things should happen so conveniently?)
Touya: (Y-You don't mean...)
Voice: (Yes, it was me. Those fools from Lin Karma
seemed to believe they had sealed Vorlia away,
but I could have left a place like that any time I wished.
I merely had no need to leave.
Above all, staying there kept them from interfering.
It suited me to play with you humans, who only patch up appearances
and cannot learn the fundamental lessons.
...And this time, that Rayblade is what will save humanity.
It is the 'key.'
The only being that can stop this Vorlia.
That is why you have been able to come this far...)
Touya: (...But the fact that we're still alive
means you lost in the past, doesn't it?)
Voice: (No, they failed. They could not even
reach me... And so, with their ambitions unfulfilled,
all of them faded into history...)
Touya: (...Then I'll end it this time.)
Voice: (Hehehe... Yes. A wager must be made
on equal terms. If I stayed somewhere safe,
I could not enjoy it in earnest.
You might call it a sense of tension.
It makes the enjoyment many times greater.
That is why I am giving you this chance.)
Touya: (...)
Voice: (If you destroy this 'Core' using Rayblade,
neither Vorlia nor I can sustain our existence, and we will vanish.
Then this world will be saved...
Hehehehe... Now, shall I begin?)
Touya: "..."
Kururu: "...Hey, what does that feel like?"
Touya: "..."
Kururu: "Touya...?"
Touya: "...Huh? What is it?"
Kururu: "What's wrong? You're just staring into space..."
Touya: "? I was... talking just now..."
Kururu: "Talking...? In that tiny bit of time?"
Touya: "...Tiny? How much time was it?"
Kururu: "About three blinks."
Voice: (Surprised? I can do this sort of thing too.)
Touya: (...You're one hell of a bastard...)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Well, shall we get started...?)
Yamato: "Wh-What is that?!"
Kururu: "A black Rayblade...?"
Touya: "...Let's go."
Kururu: "Huh?"
Touya: "Once we beat that thing, everything will be over."
Kururu: "What do you... No. All right.
If you say so, Touya, then that's how it is!"
Touya: "Sorry."
Kururu: "A guy should be a little assertive.
I kind of like you this way, Touya."
Touya: "Who taught you something like that?"
Kururu: "Hehehehe... It's a secret."
Voice: (...Hmm? Are you damaged...?
It would be no fun unless you fought me
in perfect condition... Very well.)
Kururu: "Huh?! The damage... It's healing..."
Touya: "..."
Voice: (Now, entertain me!)
Touya: (Let's finish this.)
Voice: (Heh... Hehehehe... Very well.
Then end it all with your own hands...)
Touya: (You don't have to tell me. I will.)
Voice: (Good, you are quite entertaining...
But it seems you can go no further...
Still, my excellent pawns have worked well this time,
and I have enjoyed myself... But
it is almost time to say goodbye...)
Voice: (...So you have fallen short of my expectations...
You had done well up to this point...
Even so, my excellent pawns have worked well this time,
and I have enjoyed myself... So
I shall erase you in an instant, without pain...)
Touya: "Ghh........"
Kururu: "Touya..."
Voice: (What?! I-Impossible... You...)
Kasumi: "Touya-chan! Kururu-chan! Yamato-chan!
Is everyone okay?!"
Touya: "Kasumi!"
Clovis: "Hey, looks like you're having a hard time."
Arthur: "It's hardly fair for you two alone
to take all the glory, is it?"
Kururu: "Everyone..."
Aurelie: "We made it just in time."
Fain: "You're safe now that we're here!"
Xiujian: "...Heh."
Celica: "This is the way a finale should be!"
Voice: (Why...? Breaking through that barrier...)
Rayfon: (You should not underestimate the humans of this world.
This humanity, who have established their individuality.
Alone, each one's strength is weak, but when they connect,
they manifest power beyond expectation...
That is the defining trait of humanity here.
Because they are imperfect, they try to make up for it
by cooperating with others. There arises a power
that cannot be measured in numbers or predicted.
Trust, friendship, love... It takes many forms.
Do you know its name?)
Voice: (...)
Rayfon: (Its name is... 'bonds.'
You believe only in yourselves, trust no one,
are relied on by no one, and love no one.
I doubt your kind can understand.)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Hahahahaha!
Amusing! More amusing than ever!
Very well! I shall grant you all the right
to join this wager!)
Voice: (...?! Why?! Why won't they appear?!)
Rishuna: (It is useless. We have cut off this space.
You can no longer summon anything.)
Voice: (Ghh...)
Valga: (It is about time we ended this.)
Voice: (It seems... I underestimated you somewhat...
But I can do this as well...)
Clovis: "What?! What's going on...?"
Arthur: "An illusion...? No, that's not it..."
Xiujian: "...So our final enemy is ourselves..."
Voice: (Now, let the delightful banquet begin!!)
Touya: "Our target is that black one.
We should only have to beat that thing.
I might get a little reckless..."
Kururu: "That's okay."
Touya: "Aren't you scared?"
Kururu: "I'm okay. Don't worry about me.
Do what you think is best, Touya."
Touya: "So you trust me."
Kururu: "Of course. 'Love means never doubting,' after all."
Touya: "..."
Kururu: "Wh-What?"
Touya: "...You're still too young for that."
Kururu: "Booo!"
Touya: "But I don't doubt you either."
Kururu: "...Okay."
Clovis: "Th-This is..."
Fain: "Oh!"
Celica: "I can't believe it..."
Touya: "...Let's go!!"
Kururu: "Everyone!"
Kasumi: "Touya-chan!"
Clovis: "Are you two all right?!"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Xiujian: "...It seems the battle has been decided."
Yamato: "...I'm here too, you know..."
Kururu: "Now, now..."
Voice: (...Splendid... You have entertained me most satisfactorily...)
Touya: (It's over.)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Yes...
But that does not mean everything is over...)
Touya: (...What do you mean...?)
Voice: (I will indeed vanish.
But unless you annihilate the Core,
you cannot stop Vorlia...)
Touya: (What?!)
Voice: (...It was most enjoyable...
Experiencing extinction is not so bad... either...)
Touya: (W-Wait! How can I annihilate the Core?!)
Voice: (...I told you Rayblade was the key...
You must work out what to do for yourself...)
Touya: (The key... For myself...)
Voice: (...Hehehehe... It is a pity I cannot
watch to the very end, but I wish you luck... Farewell...)
Touya: "..."
Kururu: "...Touya?"
Touya: "O-Oh... Sorry."
Kururu: "...Was someone talking to you again?"
Touya: "Kururu..."
Kururu: "What is it?"
Touya: "I'm sorry."
Kururu: "...Why are you apologizing?"
Kururu: "Huh? Wh-What...?"
Yamato: "Is Vorlia moving?
What in the world is...?"
Touya: "...Tch. It won't even give me time to think..."
Kururu: "..."
Touya: "...Listen to me."
Yamato: "Huh? Why have you switched to transmission mode?
Hey. Hey, Tou..."
Kururu: "..."
Yamato: "Huh? Why are you stopping me...?"
Kururu: "...Let's leave it to Touya.
Let's trust Touya and follow him, okay?"
Yamato: "O-Okay..."
Touya: "...I'm going to destroy Vorlia's Core now.
But only this Rayblade can do that.
So I'd like you to return ahead of us."
Fain: "Hey! What the hell do you mean?!"
Touya: "...I know I'm being selfish
asking this after we've come so far.
But it's not that I don't believe in you.
I want you to go back because I believe in you, because I trust you.
And reassure me that I have somewhere to return to,
somewhere I have to return to..."
Clovis: "Hey, you can't spring that on us after coming this far.
I'm staying with you to the end."
Xiujian: "Heh... Do you think we'd simply obey
if you told us to go back? I haven't sunk so low that I'd leave alone
and dump everything on a comrade."
Arthur: "How cold... I'll stay with you to the end."
Fain: "What are you saying?! I'm with you to the end too!"
Rayfon: "We must calmly accept reality.
There is nothing we can do right now.
It is frustrating... But it is the truth.
So we should not make this any harder for him.
If we truly believe in him, if we truly are his comrades,
we should leave this to him."
Rayfon: "...But you must keep
your promise to return."
Touya: "...Yeah. I'll try."
Clovis: "Touya... No, forget it.
It will only be a short parting."
Touya: "...I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Clovis: "Yeah. Don't die!"
Xiujian: "........I won't say farewell."
Touya: "Yeah... I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Xiujian: "...Understood."
Arthur: "...I won't say goodbye."
Touya: "Yeah. Neither will I."
Arthur: "...Be careful..."
Touya: "I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Fain: "...A-All right! But don't you dare die!
That's a promise!"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan... I'll be waiting.
So I won't say goodbye..."
Touya: "Yeah. Wait just a little while."
Kasumi: "Okay. I understand........Come back safely."
Touya: "...I'll be back."
Touya: "...Well then, let's go."
Yamato: "Go...?"
Kururu: "...You're going to use Rayblade itself, aren't you?"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Kururu: "Is that the only way?"
Touya: "...I'm sorry."
Kururu: "Honestly... Why do you keep apologizing?!"
Touya: "Kururu...?"
Kururu: "I don't regret anything, you know.
I told you to do what you thought was best, Touya, didn't I?
So don't apologize.
I'll go with you, wherever that takes us.
So don't say things like that... Please."
Touya: "...Sorry."
Kururu: "There you go again..."
Touya: "S-Sor... Oh."
Kururu: "Honestly! But even that part of you, Touya,
All of it... I love it."
Touya: "Kururu..."
Kururu: "...Hey, Touya."
Touya: "Hmm?"
Kururu: "Can I... come over there?"
Touya: "Huh? But what about the controls...?"
Kururu: "It's okay. We're not going to fight anymore,
and it should move properly even if I don't do anything.
This little one has taken in so many of our feelings..."
Touya: "...You're right... Hey, do people normally come over before getting an answer?"
Kururu: "What does it matter?
...There we go. It's a bit cramped."
Touya: "Of course it is."
Kururu: "But I can feel you closest this way, Touya.
I'm not scared now..."
Touya: "..."
Kururu: "...Hey, is your heart racing?"
Touya: "Huh?"
Kururu: "Honestly, you're this close to a girl this cute,
and you don't feel a thing?"
Touya: "What am I supposed to feel?"
Kururu: (...Sigh. Well, that's all right.
Even if it hasn't happened yet, someday, Touya, I'll fill your heart
with thoughts of me. That's my promise...)
Touya: "...Hmm? Did you say something?"
Kururu: "Nothing! More importantly, are you ready?"
Touya: "...Yeah."
Kururu: "Well then..."
Kururu: "You seem to do nothing but apologize."
Touya: "Sorry..."
Kururu: "See?"
Touya: "Oh..."
Kururu: "Hehehehe."
Touya: "...Shall we go...?"
Kururu: "Okay."
Touya: "Raaaaaaaagh!!"
